newsitem.title: USA: Bon-Ton same-store sales up 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bon-Ton same-store sales up 2 pct.

text.p: Bon-Ton Stores Inc Thursday reported sales for the four weeks, third quarter and year-to-date ended November 2 saying it continues to experience strong sales increases in the women's sportswear complex, primarily as a result of both the ongoing realignment of the moderate to better mix and the new offerings from our branded fashion vendors.

Shoes, coats, all of misses sportswear, accessories and intimate showed increases above the company average for the month. On a year-to-date basis, the Home Division has performed above average as well."
Sales in millions of dollars Percent change
Third quarter results will be released on November 21, 1996, Bon-Ton said. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
